comment: The one-quantum two slits (the owner's word of 2026-10-21: every slit experiment on the site with a description and an animation; ALGEBRA.md, The two slits' variants under the click's read, one quantum at a time; the derivation under papers/one_rule/variants/, section A, verdict WORKS): the shipped two slits' world two_slits.json with one quantum laid in place of the beam, the eighteenth of the forty worlds of the derivation's ensemble (a_one_quantum.py --ensemble 40 writes the forty at run time under a scratch folder, the amplitudes 1240 down to 1227 at the columns 10, 9 and 11, the amplitude 1240 - k div 3 and the column (10, 9, 11)[k mod 3] for the world k; this world k = 18, the amplitude 1234 at the column 10), read by build_one_quantum.py, which writes the universe file, the world file, its mode file (tools/pixel_mode.py, the packet lay) and the blind one_quantum.expectation.json. Two declarations of the world and no act (the derivation's two findings by name): (i) the universe `universe`, light.json with the quantum action times 2^12 = 134,217,728 (the energy line binds no family of this file), so that one quantum lays at the declared amplitude 1234 (the generator's 1,015 levels at the one-quantum amplitude 1240, the shipped beam's own scale) and the integer board carries the wave as the shipped run does, where at the shipped T one quantum spread over the packet's 344 Nodes stands at the integer floor and its diffraction is the walk's (item 49 of what is open: a single quantum below about 0.28 A Links travels as no wave); (ii) every exit of the record a declared detector: the region `return`, two columns deep at the source's receding face (x = 0 and 1, every row), backed by that face as the screen is backed by its own, so that the wall's return, which the shipped world's receding face lets leave uncredited, is credited (nature's wall absorbs and the quanta it takes give no dot; the law's face reflects and a receding face credits nothing; the division act N = (SUM floored inflows + W_rec div 2) div W_rec gives 0 in the shipped geometry, the screen's 0.158 of one quantum below the half unit); the draw's window 130, the whole passage, one close (the digits of the thirteen regions' 192 Nodes, 26.69 bits each, one number of about 5,120 bits read once against one quantum, no budget spent). The run is deterministic per world file (The click's read of the board: the same world read twice gives the same click; the ensemble is the variety, a knob of the world): one click at the close 130, the count 1, at one region drawn by the window's inflows as the shares and nothing left after it, the cap by the count. Every other number of the world is two_slits.json's: the board 45 x 48 x 1, the wall at 20 with the gaps [17, 19] and [29, 31], the packet at the wave [1, 4] with the edges 6 along and 2 across over the rows 4 to 44, the screen's twelve regions of four rows two columns deep at the columns 43 and 44, the receding faces at both ends of x up to 400.
